product_goal: Create a compact monitor-top desk companion that gives presence and posture cues without reading like a toy or an intrusive camera product.

hard_constraints.rule: Keep the main body within 140 x 38 x 20 mm.
Use a monitor-top contact and rear support strategy instead of a spring clamp.
Preserve access to ports and the local control zone without full disassembly.

reference_cases.lesson: A narrow horizontal body can align sensing and status hardware without dominating the display.
reference_cases.design_implication: Keep the front hierarchy shallow and preserve rear support clearance.
reference_cases.source_note: Synthetic category reference for the public example.

reference_cases.lesson: Status information should remain glanceable without resembling a face or toy.
reference_cases.design_implication: Use a restrained display window and separate it from the sensor island.
reference_cases.source_note: Synthetic category reference for the public example.

component_requirements.requirement: Fit a centered sensing package while preserving a shallow front body.
component_requirements.design_implication: The sensor island controls minimum body depth.

component_requirements.requirement: Provide glanceable status without creating a toy-like face.
component_requirements.design_implication: Reserve a quiet left-side window with controlled contrast.

component_candidates.interface_or_mounting: Rigid front datum with rear cable relief
component_candidates.risk: Actual lens and cable depth remain unverified

component_candidates.interface_or_mounting: Front window on the main PCB
component_candidates.risk: May not support the intended sensing functions
Connector and active-area dimensions vary by module

selected_components.why: It represents the higher-depth packaging case.
selected_components.fixed_constraints: Preserve a centered rigid datum and 10 mm depth allowance.
selected_components.unverified: Exact module, lens, and cable exit

selected_components.why: It supports glanceable status with low visual noise.
selected_components.fixed_constraints: Reserve a 30 x 18 mm front window zone.
selected_components.unverified: Exact active area and connector position

packaging_constraints: Reserve rear cable relief behind the centered sensor.
Keep the display and sensor mounting datums independent.
Preserve right-side access for service and power connections.
sourcing_risks: The public example uses synthetic component envelopes rather than current supplier parts.
Display connector and camera cable orientation must be verified before CAD freeze.

mounting_strategy.contact_points: small front contact point and rear support arm
mounting_strategy.support_logic: Use stable contact geometry and center-of-mass placement rather than a spring clamp.
mounting_strategy.service_access_notes: Keep the right-side service area reachable in-place.

style_features.name: quiet bar silhouette
style_features.rule: Preserve a long horizontal body with restrained height.

style_features.name: ordered front hierarchy
style_features.rule: Keep left display, central sensor, and right service area visually legible.

style_features.name: controlled facets
style_features.rule: Use subtle chamfers or facets instead of heavy curves.

manufacturing_risks: The right-side service zone may become too crowded for ports and button access.
The rear support arm may read thinner than the required structure.
Camera depth and alignment may conflict with a shallow main body.
forbidden_features: A hidden service port that requires full shell removal
Front-face asymmetry that breaks left-to-right clarity

acceptance_checks.title: Main body envelope
acceptance_checks.method: Measure the draft body bounding box.
acceptance_checks.pass_condition: At or below 140 x 38 x 20 mm.

acceptance_checks.title: Mounting credibility
acceptance_checks.method: Review the side profile and support geometry.
acceptance_checks.pass_condition: The device reads as physically stable on a monitor top edge.

acceptance_checks.title: Front-face order
acceptance_checks.pass_condition: Display, sensor, and service areas remain clearly ordered.

acceptance_checks.title: Service access
acceptance_checks.pass_condition: Basic service interactions remain reachable without major disassembly.
